preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
Number of flavors in each test case is between 1 and 100.
Cost of each flavor is between 1 and 10^9 burles.

postconditions.expression: for each test case, output is a single integer representing the minimum number of coins needed.
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the minimum number of coins required to make any flavor's cost using 1, 2, and 3 burle coins.
